deploy-bot: RC created: rc-2026-03-15 for inference-runtime (sha: b4f2c9a). Target envs: staging -> canary -> prod. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC 2026-03-16.
caroline: thanks. attaching the release notes and the checklist I posted in the doc link: https://redwood.internal/releases/rc-2026-03-15
anish: quick QA summary: smoke tests passed on staging, but I saw 2x increased memory on the long-seq path during the 90s load test. logs attached: `tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/runtime.log` showed multiple kvcache GC spikes.
maya: saw the same. filing a bug: #INF-492. Primarily affects models with seq_len>8k. For the RC we should pin to quantized-2 variant which avoids the path.
james: ops note: dedicated cluster has GPUs with driver 535; the runtime change includes a new kernel that expects 540 but we have a fallback. Performance difference minimal, but we should be prepared to rollback if kernel-level OOMs appear.
caroline: decision needed: do we pin RC to quantized-2 + model v1.3.4 (safe) or go with model v1.4.0 (improvements but risk)?
oliver: product sign-off leaning conservative — v1.3.4 for now. We can schedule v1.4.0 for next minor with canary ramp.
eva: oncall: change window ok for infra. I'll be oncall for the window and will coordinate with SRE team.
caroline: checklist summary: 1) pin model to v1.3.4, 2) update runtime config to enable kvcache throttle, 3) deploy RC to canary 5% for 30m, 4) metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, token throughput, OOMs, KV GC events.
deploy-bot: Deployment request queued: `/deploy rc-2026-03-15 --env=canary --percent=5 --timeout=1800`. Requested by caroline.
